## Problem and outcome

Which supported promise or concrete defect does this address? What changes for
the operator? Optional future features should name their intended release.

## Scope and stopping point

State the observation that justifies the work, the smallest complete change,
and the finite acceptance result. No additional issue or approval is required
for routine work already within the agreed scope.

## Validation and reuse

Link the compact validation receipt, relevant reused evidence/reviews and any
explicitly unavailable checks. Keep raw logs outside the PR description. Physical
results must name the actual configuration; do not infer them from software tests.

## Delivery and limits

Identify runtime/profile/packaging changes, user-facing guide updates and real
remaining limits. Separate candidate artifacts from accepted release assets.
